name: PizzARIA ALPIN
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to PizzARIA ALPIN in Tirol!**

Discover authentic Italian flavors in the heart of the Alps. Our cozy restaurant in **Innsbruck** serves up delicious homemade pizzas, fresh pasta, and classic Italian dishes—all with a touch of **Tirol** charm.

Try our famous **Kaiserschmarrn** for dessert or enjoy a glass of local **Tiroler Apfelstrudel** wine. Whether you're craving a hearty meal or a relaxed evening, we’re your perfect spot in the mountains.

Come visit us and taste the best of Italy and **Tirol**! 🍕⛰️
